title: {{name}} and the Baby Dinosaur
summary: 孵蛋+帮宝宝找妈妈团聚:公园大蛋孵出小恐龙想找妈妈,一起走到小山找到恐龙妈妈团聚。
text:
{{name}} likes dinosaurs a lot.
Today {{name}} goes to the park.
Look! There is a big egg.
The egg is round and warm.
Now the egg shakes a little.
A baby dinosaur comes out!
It is small and green.
"Hello!" says the little dino.
{{name}} wants to help it.
The baby wants its mom.
But where is mom now?
{{name}} is brave and kind.
They walk to the green hill.
A big dino waits there.
It is the baby's mom!
The mom dino is very happy.
The baby runs to its mom.
"Thank you!" the mom dino smiles.
{{name}} feels warm and glad.
{{name}} likes new friends today.
Dinosaurs are the best!
